Rules:
- Use shadcn components + Tailwind utility classes only. Never write custom CSS. If a shadcn component is missing from src/components/ui, add it with the shadcn CLI. NOTE: `pnpm`/`pnpm exec` refuse to run here because node_modules is a symlink outside the worktree; use `npx shadcn@latest add <name>` or `./node_modules/.bin/shadcn add <name>` instead, and run tools as `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`, `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --deny-warnings .`, `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --write .`. Make sure the shadcn CLI writes into the worktree's src/components/ui, and that it does not modify package.json/lockfile unexpectedly (base-nova breadcrumb should need no new deps; if it adds one, report it).
- Minimal, boring code. No new abstractions beyond what's described. Preserve accessible names used by e2e tests (tests/review.spec.ts): heading "Sign up requests" and link "Back to requests" live in other components — do not touch src/components/review-queue.tsx, review-workspace.tsx, review-request.tsx in this task.

TASK: polish the admin dashboard shell at src/app/review/layout.tsx and src/components/review-sidebar.tsx.

1. Sidebar header (review-sidebar.tsx): replace the plain text span with the shadcn sidebar-07-style brand item: SidebarMenu > SidebarMenuItem > SidebarMenuButton size="lg" rendered as a Link to "/review" (`render={<Link href="/review" />}`), containing a `flex aspect-square size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-sidebar-primary text-sidebar-primary-foreground` square with lucide `UsersRoundIcon` (className size-4) — this matches the brand mark in src/components/auth-shell.tsx — and a two-line text block: "PM3 Muenchen e.V." (truncate font-medium) and "Workspace admin" (truncate text-xs). It collapses naturally in icon mode, so drop the `group-data-[collapsible=icon]:hidden` hack.
   Rename the nav group label from "Workspace" to "Administration", and the menu item label/tooltip from "Signup Review" to "Signup requests". Keep the icon.
2. Header (layout.tsx): add the shadcn `breadcrumb` component. Replace the h1 "Signup Review" with a breadcrumb. Since the layout is a server component, create a tiny client component in `src/components/review-breadcrumb.tsx` using `usePathname()`:
   - On "/review": Breadcrumb > BreadcrumbList > BreadcrumbItem > BreadcrumbPage "Signup requests".
   - On "/review/<id>": BreadcrumbItem > BreadcrumbLink to "/review" "Signup requests" (base-nova BreadcrumbLink likely takes `render={<Link href="/review" />}`; check the generated file), BreadcrumbSeparator, BreadcrumbItem > BreadcrumbPage "Request details".
   Keep header as `flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 px-4` with SidebarTrigger (add `className="-ml-1"`) and the vertical Separator (add `mr-2`), then the breadcrumb. Add `border-b` to the header? No — keep it borderless but give SidebarInset content consistent padding as today.
3. Do not change anything else.

VERIFY: tsc, oxlint, oxfmt (write, then re-check lint) must pass. Commit in the worktree in 1-2 small commits with concise imperative messages (e.g. "Add breadcrumb to the review header", "Brand the review sidebar"). No Co-Authored-By trailers. Include the generated src/components/ui/breadcrumb.tsx in the commit.

Report back: files changed, commit hashes, anything you could not do.

content.text:
The sidebar and header changes are done and committed on `ui/dashboard-shell` in the worktree. tsc, oxlint (`--deny-warnings`), and oxfmt all pass.

**Commits**
- `0583188` Brand the review sidebar and rename its nav items
- `cfc7e93` Add breadcrumb to the review header

**Files changed**
- `src/components/review-sidebar.tsx`: the brand item is a `SidebarMenuButton size="lg"` rendered as a Link to `/review`, with the `UsersRoundIcon` square and the two-line "PM3 Muenchen e.V." / "Workspace admin" block. The group label is now "Administration", and the nav item is "Signup requests" (label and tooltip). The `group-data-[collapsible=icon]:hidden` hack is gone.
- `src/app/review/layout.tsx`: `SidebarTrigger` gets `-ml-1`, the separator gets `mr-2`, and the h1 is replaced by `<ReviewBreadcrumb />`.
- `src/components/review-breadcrumb.tsx` (new): client component using `usePathname()`. On `/review` it shows the current page "Signup requests". On `/review/<id>` it shows a link "Signup requests" (`render={<Link href="/review" />}`), a separator, and "Request details".
- `src/components/ui/breadcrumb.tsx` (new, shadcn-generated): the CLI wrote only this file. `package.json` and the lockfile are unchanged, so there were no new dependencies.

**One deviation from the spec**
- The generated `breadcrumb.tsx` puts `role="link"` on `BreadcrumbPage`, which trips `jsx-a11y/prefer-tag-over-role` and fails oxlint. I added the file-level `/* oxlint-disable jsx-a11y/prefer-tag-over-role */` line, the same way `ui/input-group.tsx` already does. The `role` is shadcn's intentional `aria-disabled` current-page marker, so I left it alone.

**Not done / unverified**
- I did not run the Playwright e2e suite. I grepped `tests/` and `src/` for the old labels and found no references to "Signup Review", "Workspace", or "PM3 Muenchen" that the renames would break.
- I did not touch `review-queue.tsx`, `review-workspace.tsx`, or `review-request.tsx`.
